units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:13">Num. R. s. 3</cite> <he>המטילים מ׳ וכ׳</he> those who caused strife between him and her.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:12">Ib.</cite> <he>אף הם היו בעלי מ׳</he> they, too, were men of strife.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 20:1">Pesik. R. s. 20</cite> <he>מימיכם אנשי מ׳ אתם</he> you have at all times been in the opposition.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 20:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אתם עומדים במדינה</he> (corr. acc.) you are of the opposition.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 103:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. CIII</cite> <he>עשיתי מ׳</he> I entered a contest.
